title: Turn thin peer boot on by default
action: Follow the Contract in docs/history/thin-boot-default/plan.md: one function owns the dispatch.thin_peer_boot rule (absent or anything but explicit false = on); hooks/mod.rs thin_peer_boot and herding/run.rs thin_peer_env both call it; marker and Claude-only requirements stay. Update tests that assumed absent = off to the new rule; add tests for absent=on and explicit false=off in both paths. Write the concept docs/knowledge/areas/bee-herding/thin-peer-boot.md and link it from the area overview, citing thin-worker-boot CONTEXT D-numbers only (no raw decision ids). Write tests first and watch them fail.
